pageDescription: The upcoming {many}, with their date, place and how to sign up.
pastDescription: A look back at what already took place: photos, videos and memories.
searchPlaceholder: A word from the title, place…
emptyUpcoming: Nothing planned for now. Come back soon!
emptyPast: Nothing to look back on yet: what has finished will appear here.
subscribeLink: Subscribe to the agenda (to follow it in your own calendar)
calDescription: The dates of {month}, day by day.
videoPrivacy: YouTube receives nothing until you click.
memUnavailable: The photos or the video are not available right now. Please come back a little later.
bannerCancelled: Cancelled: this will not take place.
bannerPostponed: Postponed: the new date is not known yet. Check this page again.
noPage: This agenda has no page on the site yet: give it a path in the “General” tab.
zoneInfo: The times you write are in the **{zone}** time zone (change it in the “Settings” tab). Each date can have its own, in “More options”.
readOnly: You can read the agenda but not change it: you lack the right “write and organise the events”.
fTimeHelp: Example: 14:30 or 2:30 pm. Leave empty for a whole day.
fPlaceHelp: Written the way you want it read. Example: Community hall, 12 Lilac Street
fTextHelp: A few sentences. **bold**, *italic*, [a link](https://example.org) and lists with “-” are understood.
fPublishNowHelp: Untick to keep it as a draft: nobody sees it until you publish it.
addedPublished: Added and published. You can complete the page below.
addedDraft: Added as a draft. You can complete the page below.
fTypeNone: No type defined: add some in the “Types and files” tab.
fStatusHelp: A draft is only seen by you.
fStateHelp: “Full”, “Cancelled” and “Postponed” are shown plainly on the site.
byAssistant: prepared by the assistant, to review
brokenHelp: The date of this item cannot be read: fix it below. Until then it stays invisible to visitors.
note_gap: This time does not exist that day (clocks go forward): the next valid time is used.
note_fold: This time happens twice that day (clocks go back): the first one is used.
fToSeries: Also apply to the next {n} dates of this series
fToSeriesHelp: Changes the title, type, place, text, programme, speakers, picture and links of the following dates. Never the dates.
moreOptions: More options (end, programme, picture, sign-up, album…)
seePage: See the public page of this date
fEndDate: Last day (if it lasts several days)
fEndDateHelp: Leave empty for a single day.
fTzHelp: Only change it if this happens elsewhere, or online from another country.
fLatHelp: A number, for example 50.8466. With the longitude, the place can show on a map.
fProgramHelp:
Time at the start of each line, then the title; add “|” for a detail. Example:
14:00-14:30 Welcome | free coffee
14:30 Drawing workshop
fSpeakersHelp:
Name, then “|” and the role, then “|” and a link (optional: an https address or a page of the site). Example:
Camille Dupont | Illustrator | /team/camille
fImageHelp: A photo or a poster, preferably wide.
fImageAltHelp: For people who cannot see it. Example: Workshop poster, a pencil on a yellow background
fSignupHelp: An https address to your form, or mailto:you@example.org. Never a payment here.
fSeatsLeftHelp: Update it yourself. 0 shows “Full”. Leave empty to show nothing.
fVideoHelp: A YouTube link (it only loads on click), or an mp4 / webm file of your site.
afterTitle: After the date: photos and video
fAlbumHelp: Chosen among your albums. It shows on the page once the date has passed.
fAlbumLinkHelp: An https address. Used if you have no album on the site.
fLibVideoHelp: Chosen among your videos. It shows with the memories.
pickKept: (choice kept, but not found right now)
pickMore: Only the first 50 are offered. For another one, paste a link instead.
albumsAbsent: You have no photo albums on this site: paste a link to your photos, or install the gallery.
albumsDown: Your albums are not answering right now. Your choice is kept; try again in a moment.
videosAbsent: You have no video library on this site: you can paste a YouTube link above.
videosDown: Your video library is not answering right now. Your choice is kept; try again in a moment.
repeatInSeries: This date belongs to a series of {n} dates. Edit one, then tick “Also apply to the next dates” to align them all.
fEveryHelp: Each date keeps the same local time, summer and winter.
every_month: every month (same day of the month)
fCountHelp: This one counts. Example: 10. {max} at most. Or give a last day below.
fUntilHelp: 3 years after the first one at most.
repeated: {n} dates in all in the series.
repeatCut: The series was cut: {max} dates and {years} years at most.
confirmDelete: Delete this date? This cannot be undone.
duplicated: Copy created as a draft: change the date and whatever needs it.
savedSeries: Also applied to {n} dates of the series.
searchHelp: Looks in the title, place, text and speakers.
listEmpty: No date yet. Add the first one with the small form above.
errFull: The agenda is full: {max} dates at most. Delete the oldest ones.
errMissing: This date no longer exists. Reload the page.
errAlready: This date already belongs to a series.
errTypesFull: You reached {max} types: delete one first.
typesHelp: A type sorts your dates (and works as a filter on the site). You choose its name, its colour and, if you like, a small icon.
typesNone: No type yet. Pick a starting template below, or create your own.
typeRemoved: Type deleted. The dates that had it no longer have a type.
confirmDeleteType: Delete this type? The dates that have it will have no type.
fTypeNameHelp: Example: Workshop. Write it in each language of your site if you have several.
fColorHelp: The “theme” colours follow your site's colours; the others are sober shades. The text always stays readable.
moveEdge: It is already at the end of the list.
starterMore: Add the types of a starting template
starterHelp: {summary} You can then rename, recolour or delete each type: nothing is compulsory.
starterDone: {n} types added. You can edit them in the “Types and files” tab.
starterNothing: These types already exist: nothing was added.
filesHelp: Export your dates to a spreadsheet, or import some from a file (up to {max} lines). Columns understood, in French or in English: {columns}… Importing the same file again creates no duplicates.
fFileHelp: A spreadsheet saved as CSV. The first line gives the column names; “title” and “date” are required.
fDryHelp: Advised the first time: you read the report, then untick and run again.
fImportPublishHelp: Otherwise they arrive as drafts (unless the file has a “publication” column).
repDry: {valid} of {total} lines are ready to import.
repNewTypes: Types that will be or were created: {names}.
repTooMany: Only the first {max} lines are read.
repNoColumns: I cannot find the “title” and “date” columns on the first line.
err_titleRequired: Write a title. Example: Introduction to illustration workshop
err_typeBad: This type does not exist. Pick one in the list, or add it in the “Types and files” tab.
err_dateBad: This date cannot be read. Write it like this: 2026-11-14 or 14/11/2026.
err_timeBad: This time cannot be read. Examples: 14:30, 2:30 pm or 9am.
err_endBefore: The end must come after the start. Example: start 14:00, end 17:00.
err_zoneBad: This time zone is unknown. Pick one from the list.
err_latBad: The latitude is a number between -90 and 90. Example: 50.8466
err_lngBad: The longitude is a number between -180 and 180. Example: 4.3528
err_coordPair: Fill in the latitude AND the longitude, or neither.
err_imageBad: This picture cannot be used. Upload a file, or write an address that starts with https://
err_urlBad: Write a full address. Example: https://www.example.org/sign-up
err_seatsOver: There cannot be more places left than the total ({total}).
err_videoBad: Paste a YouTube link (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=…) or the address of an .mp4 or .webm file.
err_pickBad: This choice is not valid. Pick from the list.
err_programLine: Line {line}: start with the time. Example: 14:30 Drawing workshop
err_slotEnd: Line {line}: the end must come after the start. Example: 14:00-15:30 Welcome
err_speakerLine: Line {line}: write at least a name. Example: Camille Dupont | Illustrator
err_speakerLink: Line {line}: the link must be an https address or a page of the site. Example: https://www.example.org/camille or /team/camille
err_typeNameRequired: Give this type a name. Example: Workshop
err_colorBad: Pick a colour from the list.
err_typeDuplicate: A type already has this name. Pick another one.
err_stateBad: Unknown situation. Write: normal, full, cancelled or postponed.
err_publicationBad: Unknown publication. Write: published or draft.
err_countRule: Write a whole number of at least 2 and at most {max}. Example: 10
err_repeatNeed: Give the number of dates (example: 10, {max} at most) or a last day.
err_repeatNone: With these settings there is no extra date. Raise the number or move the last day later.
err_untilBefore: The last day must come after the date of this item.
err_fileEmpty: Choose a (.csv) file that contains dates.
err_fileColumns: I cannot find the “title” and “date” columns on the first line of the file.
err_starterBad: Pick a template from the list.
